items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 37:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the drawing in the secret of coupling? The drawing of the Mochin, that they should be the aspect of GAR in the head of the Nukva, is called the drawing of the Mochin in the secret of a Partzuf, meaning to be the aspect of GAR to the Partzuf itself. And these Mochin that are drawn to the Yesod of the Nukva at the time of the face-to-face coupling are not for the building of the Partzuf of the Nukva herself, but only for Mochin for the sake of the souls, and they are called the drawing in the secret of coupling. (Item 109).
